relationship_coverage.note: drawn as the observed fact (seven NICs with no link). The brief forbids claiming cable absence from inactive ports, so the label states the observation instead of 'no cable'; the unproven part is not asserted in the diagram.
direction preserved (host owns the single active interface).
neighbouring server routed by the same gateway.
the question mark carries the brief's qualification that unresponsive addresses do not prove the addresses are free.

node_coverage.drawn_as: A and B: 'Arista .57 AS132717' (shared boundary node in both views)
B: 'Cloudflare 1.1.1.1' (AS13335 omitted for width; see abbreviations)

abbreviations.ms: milliseconds of observed round-trip latency from the source brief
abbreviations.R7725: Dell PowerEdge R7725 (brand omitted for box width)
abbreviations.OUI: MAC address vendor prefix, mentioned only in the qualifications, not in the diagram

qualifications: Arista identity is MAC-OUI derived: the gateway node says 'Arista .57 AS132717', never 'ToR', so the diagram does not assert the ToR role that the brief says MAC OUI cannot prove.
Seven dark NICs are drawn as an observation ('7 NICs dark' / '7 dark ports'); the diagram does not assert that those ports have no cable.
The .60-.62 addresses are labelled with a question mark ('free? in /29') because no response was observed rather than proven absence of use.
No spine, leaf, VXLAN or MPLS device is drawn: the source says traceroute cannot see them, and the brief forbids inventing them.
abstractions: One 9-node/8-edge graph does not fit 77x47: a single 7-layer tb spec measures 64x56 cells (attempts/v1-full-tb.json), taller than the 47-row pane. The graph is therefore split into view A (host, ports, /29, gateway) and view B (hops above the gateway), with the Arista .57 gateway drawn in both views as the shared boundary node. No relationship is dropped.

Deliberate omissions (not relationships in the source facts, and drawing them would invent structure): 'no NAT, public L3 straight to the host, no IPv6', server uptime (1.5 days), 'no GPUs / no rack-bench yet', and the general note that everything above the ToR is invisible from the host.

View A is intentionally static (0 flows). An animated variant (attempts/vA-host-tor-flow.json, captured in captures/superseded-vA-flow/) put flow dots on the two short active-path stems; on stems shorter than the renderer's 7-cell dot spacing the dots crowded two rows apart and replaced route corner glyphs, so the static version was kept. That is a rendering choice, not a relationship change.

defects.defect: Source stems and arrowheads attach one cell inside the node's left corner rather than at the box centre: dark stem at col 13 of a box spanning 12-24, s1 arrow at col 10 of 9-27, and the three gw fan-in arrowheads at cols 9/11/13 of 8-28.
defects.impact: Ports are distinct cells (no shared corridor, no false branch), but the gateway's three in-edges read as a left-side bundle instead of a fanned fan-in.
defects.mitigation: kept; moving them is not expressible in the spec

defects.defect: The 'free? in /29' label sits on the arrowhead row rather than on its own horizontal run (the run is one row above), one corridor away from the 'same /29' label.
defects.impact: label ownership is inferred by proximity; both labels are inside their corridors' span, so no label is attached to the wrong edge, but the pairing is less explicit than for the other three edges

defects.defect: Node labels are single-line, so two source facts had to be shortened: 'Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 AS13335' is drawn as 'Cloudflare 1.1.1.1', and 'Dell PowerEdge R7725' as 'R7725'.
defects.impact: vendor/AS detail for the endpoint and server brand are not visible on screen; both are listed in node_coverage and abbreviations

defects.defect: Selection is carried by bold plus the accent colour only; the plain-text capture is byte-identical between selected and unselected states.
defects.impact: a text-only reader cannot tell which node is selected; the ANSI captures (selected-1/selected-2) are required to see it

defects.defect: The selection/flow accent (216,166,87) is the same RGB triple as the first shade of the layer-0 hue family, so in both views a selected node is the same colour as the unselected layer-0 node.
defects.impact: selection reads only from the bold weight plus the colour change of a non-layer-0 node; the accent is not reserved exclusively for selection as the candidate skill claims

defects.defect: Flow dots overwrite route corner glyphs on the two short jogs under the gateway and under Airtel: frame4 shows '●─●' where the ╰ and ╮ corners should be, frame2 shows '●╯' replacing a ╭ corner.
defects.impact: for those frames the dogleg is momentarily unreadable as a continuous route; the endpoints and arrowheads stay correct

defects.defect: Two dots appear on the same short jog at the same time (frames 2 and 4), well inside the renderer's 7-cell dot spacing rule.
defects.impact: reads as two flows on one hop; spacing is a renderer property of short segments and could not be fixed from the spec without deleting the animation

defects.defect: The chain occupies cols 29-49 of the 77-column pane, leaving roughly 28 empty columns; extent is 22x29 in a 77x47 viewport.
defects.impact: no clipping and no overflow badge, but the pane is under-used; an 'lr' layout cannot help (measured 102x5 and 119x5 for this chain, wider than the pane)
